name: io.github.MikolajSapek/dojazdomat
title: Dojazdomat
description: Warsaw commute times and rent medians by area; rank office locations from staff postcodes.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description:
Find transit stop groups and neighborhoods by name and get their lat/lon (znajdz przystanek lub osiedle po nazwie).
Use the coordinates as input for the other tools.

query.description: Name fragment, e.g. 'Kabaty', 'Rondo ONZ', 'Mokotow'. Diacritics optional.
query.title: Query

tools.name: commute_time
tools.description:
Minutes from home (from) to work (to), same model as the Dojazdomat map (czas dojazdu z domu do pracy). transit:
door to door by public transport plus walking, weekday 7-9 average, with the nearest stops at both ends; bike, walk: OpenStreetMap
paths (bike +2 min); car: rush-hour driving. minutes is null when unreachable (over 120 min).

mode.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode.title: Mode

transit_modes.description: transit only: which public transport to use, e.g. ['metro'] = metro only, ['metro', 'tram']; rail = SKM, KM, WKD trains. Default all. [] = walking only / tylko wybrane srodki transportu
transit_modes.title: Transit Modes

tools.name: rent_stats
tools.description:
Asking-rent statistics (n, median, p25, p75) of rental ads within radius_m of a point (statystyki cen najmu w promieniu).
Aggregates only; if fewer than 20 ads match, the result is suppressed (widen radius or relax filters). Radius is snapped to a fixed step (see radius_m) so queries cannot be differenced to single ads.

radius_m.description: Radius in metres, 200-5000; snapped to the nearest of 300, 500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 5000 (the answer states the radius used)
radius_m.title: Radius M

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

tools.name: rank_neighborhoods
tools.description:
Rank Warsaw neighborhoods for a workplace: median rent, commute minutes, value score (rent vs typical rent in the same
commute band, like the map), monthly_cost (rent + commute valued at the minimum wage) and Pareto flag (no neighborhood both faster and cheaper)
(ranking osiedli: czynsz, dojazd, wartosc, front Pareto). Same data and rules as the map: neighborhoods with fewer than 20 ads are skipped. Sorted by best (rent + commute cost; the map itself now opens on fastest first) unless sort is given.

max_rent.description: Max neighborhood median rent (PLN, or PLN/m2 if measure=per_m2)
max_rent.title: Max Rent

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

sort.description: best = rent + commute valued at the minimum wage (default for measure=total; the map itself now opens on fastest first); value (default for per_m2) = score vs typical rent in the same commute band; commute = fastest first; rent = cheapest first
sort.title: Sort

mode.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode.title: Mode

transit_modes.description: transit only: which public transport to use, e.g. ['metro'] = metro only, ['metro', 'tram']; rail = SKM, KM, WKD trains. Default all. [] = walking only / tylko wybrane srodki transportu
transit_modes.title: Transit Modes

tools.name: rank_for_two
tools.description:
Rank Warsaw neighborhoods for two people who work in two places (para, dwa biura): median rent, both commutes and
monthly_cost (rent + both commutes valued at the minimum wage). Each person can use a different mode. Neighborhoods with
fewer than 20 ads are skipped.

mode_a.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode_a.title: Mode A

mode_b.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode_b.title: Mode B

max_commute_min.description: Max commute minutes for each person
max_commute_min.title: Max Commute Min

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

sort.description: best = rent + both commutes valued at the minimum wage (default); fair = shortest longer commute first; rent = cheapest first
sort.title: Sort

transit_modes.description: transit only: which public transport to use, e.g. ['metro'] = metro only, ['metro', 'tram']; rail = SKM, KM, WKD trains. Default all. [] = walking only / tylko wybrane srodki transportu
transit_modes.title: Transit Modes

tools.name: compare_neighborhoods
tools.description:
Compare 2-4 neighborhoods side by side (porownaj osiedla): median rent, p25, p75 and number of ads, plus the commute to
an optional workplace. A neighborhood with fewer than 20 matching ads shows suppressed instead of a price.

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

mode.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode.title: Mode

tools.name: reachable_neighborhoods
tools.description:
Every neighborhood from which this point (e.g. the office) is reached within max_minutes, fastest first (zasieg w N minut).
Lists also neighborhoods with too few ads for a price (median_rent null), unlike rank_neighborhoods.

max_minutes.description: Max minutes from home to this point
max_minutes.title: Max Minutes

mode.description: transit (default, weekday morning public transport + walking), bike, walk or car (rush hour) / komunikacja, rower, pieszo, auto
mode.title: Mode

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

transit_modes.description: transit only: which public transport to use, e.g. ['metro'] = metro only, ['metro', 'tram']; rail = SKM, KM, WKD trains. Default all. [] = walking only / tylko wybrane srodki transportu
transit_modes.title: Transit Modes

tools.name: rent_trend
tools.description:
Median asking rent per day of data for the city, a district or a neighborhood, and the change between the first and the last
day (trend czynszu). Daily snapshots of the map's own data; days with fewer than 20 ads show null.

area.description: 'Warszawa' (default) for the whole city, a district or a neighborhood name
area.title: Area

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

tools.name: rank_office_locations
tools.description:
Best offices to rent in Warsaw for a team, from the employees' postcodes (gdzie wynajac biuro: ranking biur dla zespolu).
Scores every office in a finne.pl sample by commute home -> office (public transport, weekday 7-9) and returns the top
`limit`: mean and worst minutes, people over 45 min, people without a transit trip, rent per m2 and currency, area range,
finne.pl link. Same numbers as dojazdomat.pl/biuro/. Postcodes are processed in memory and not stored or logged.
The answer says how many codes were unknown, approximate or outside the grid.

postcodes.description: One postcode per employee, form NN-NNN, up to 1000 entries (repeat a code for several people). Covered city area only.
postcodes.title: Postcodes

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: Data dates, sources, listing counts per portal, method notes and caveats (zrodla, daty, ograniczenia danych).
